<h2>Request to Address Council</h2>
<p>To allow members of the public an opportunity to address Council on matters of concern, the Council has decided to set aside a maximum of 15 minutes at the start of each General Meeting, for this purpose. The matter must be one of public interest related to local government and it is to be a submission to Council. Council will not enter into a question and answer session.</p>
<p>Rules have been adopted so that the session will run smoothly, to the maximum benefit of all concerned.</p>
<p>The rules are:-</p>
<ol style="margin-left: 40px;">
<li>The session is for a maximum of 15 minutes, with a maximum of three speakers per session. It is advisable to notify the Chief Executive Officer beforehand of the wish to address Council, as the first to indicate will receive first priority and so on.</li>
<li>The right of any individual to address Council during the public session is at the absolute discretion of the Council.</li>
<li>The session is under the control of the person chairing the meeting. A person making a submission must cease talking if and when required by the Chair.</li>
<li>A person addressing the Council must stand and act and speak with decorum and frame any remarks in respectful and courteous language.</li>
<li>The Chair may require a person to cease making the submission if an address or comment is irrelevant, offensive or unduly long.</li>
</ol>
<p>Download the <a title="" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/your-council/documents/council-meetings/request_to_address_council.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Request to Address Council<span class="file-info">(PDF, 115KB)</span></a> form. Please complete and email to <a href="mailto:info@sbrc.qld.gov.au">info@sbrc.qld.gov.au</a> or post to PO Box 336 Kingaroy QLD 4610</p>

        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>
